observations: Photo 0 shows a large industrial machine with teal/white body, multiple rollers/heads, and a long infeed/outfeed area; looks like a printing/packaging or paper-processing press.
Photo 0 includes a visible conveyor/bed area with metal guides and a control panel area on the right.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from another angle with a front control panel (buttons/indicators) and a long work path; there is a safety/guarding structure above.
No clear brand/model plate, serial number, or nameplate is readable in either photo.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the machine running, no close-up of a working display, and no test output is shown.

risks.risk: Exact machine type/model is unclear from photos; pricing depends heavily on whether it’s a specific printing/packaging press and its capacity.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the machine’s nameplate/brand plate/serial number (and model) on the body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified industrial machine with unknown specs (worst-case: needs inspection/possible parts), not guaranteed to match the expected category.

risks.risk: “Perfect working condition” may be untrue; photos don’t confirm operation, calibration, or that all functions work.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running through a full cycle (start-up to completion) with the control panel active.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Wear/hidden damage (rollers, belts, gears, electrical components) may not be visible in still images.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wear points: rollers/bearings, belts/drive components, and any visible oil leaks or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming normal-to-worse wear and potential servicing needs.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (dies, guides, tooling, manuals, spare parts) can make the machine unusable for the buyer’s job.
risks.proof: A photo list of included tooling/accessories (dies, clamps, guides, manuals, power cables) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only, without guaranteed tooling/accessories.

proof_requests: Clear nameplate/serial/model plate photo (both sides if needed).
Video of the machine running a full cycle with output (showing the work path and any counters/indicators).
Close-ups of rollers/belts/drive area and any electrical/control panel details.
List and photos of included tooling/accessories and whether manuals/spares are included.
response.reason: The photos show an industrial press-like machine, but the exact model/type and working status are not verifiable from still images. Without a readable nameplate and a running test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
